usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Resolutions Hay.chat counts for billing, and the ledger behind the number.

meter.title: Billable resolutions
meter.periodNote: Counted over your billing period, the same dates as your invoice.
meter.planNote: Your plan's allowance and any extra-resolution charges are on your billing page.
meter.paused: The AI agent is paused because the plan's resolutions are used up. Conversations wait for your team.
meter.calendarNote: Counted per calendar month (UTC). Your invoice may use different period dates.

outcomes.human: Handed off, not resolved by the AI

ledger.title: Resolution ledger
ledger.description: Every resolution counted in this period, with the reason it counted.
ledger.exclusionsClosed: Resolutions from this period can no longer be excluded here.
ledger.empty: No billable resolutions in this period.

outcomes.assumed: AI answered, shopper did not come back

excludeDialog.title: Exclude this resolution

excludeDialog.review: You have used this period's self-serve exclusions (5 % of resolutions). This request goes to Hay.chat for review, and the resolution stays counted until then.
